findings.title: Conversation gate loads full history per call
findings.problem: get_workspace now calls ensure_conversation_readable, which runs Conversation.find_by_id (loads and materializes workflow history) and an Ability check on every call. Per-file operations and tool-call loops invoke get_workspace repeatedly, so each repeats the full conversation load although the ownership check needs only the conversation's user_id.
findings.impact: Added latency only, no behavior consequence; trigger is long or workflow-materialized conversations combined with many workspace operations or script tool-call loops. Read from the code: no caching or per-request reuse exists.
findings.recommendation: Fetch only the conversation owner (or cache the readability result per workspace within a request) instead of materializing the full history on each get_workspace call.

disposition.rationale: User chose fix-now: add Conversation.find_owner_ref and use it in ensure_conversation_readable
